action_items: (Non-blocking / nice-to-have) The '+ Ajouter un item' button in admin.html uses the .btn-secondary styling which renders in a light grey. Visually it can look like it might be disabled; consider a distinct primary-outline style to make it more obviously actionable. It IS fully clickable.

(Non-blocking) The failing-quiz path was validated by (i) reading the JSX, (ii) confirming resultEncouragement uses colors.warning (#F39C12 orange), and (iii) POSTing a wrong-answer completion which returned {passing:false}. A full UI screen-capture of the orange 'Dommage…' text was not obtained because the 3-question quiz for Saison test 1 is already locked (all seed families that have episodes done have already taken it). If the main agent wants a visual regression on this text, temporarily reset a family with `db.users.update_one({email:'...'},{'$set':{completed_quizzes:[]}})` or add a wipe endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:974-990 — completed_seasons logic correctly uses `needed = min(expected, len(season_episodes))`, which handles the case where a season is under-populated relative to its expected_episodes count. Boundary check `needed > 0` prevents empty-season false positives. Good.

session/[episodeId].tsx:207-246 (handleBack) — the branch for `cards_after` correctly falls back to game → last card → video in that order, matching the forward-navigation order. `canGoBack` is `false` on 'video' (correct — first step, no earlier state) and on all celebration/reward/planning/closing_message steps (correct — rewards already granted, can't be re-consumed).

quiz/[seasonId].tsx:220-224 — using `!result.passing` (not `result.passing === false`) is safe here because `passing` is guaranteed to be a boolean from the backend (server.py:608 `passing = ratio > QUIZ_PASSING_RATIO`).

family-wall.tsx:32 — `completed_seasons: number` correctly added to the ProgressData type. The stat card defaults to `progressData?.completed_seasons || 0`, so pre-migration users without the field are handled gracefully.

admin.html:1330-1334 (removeRankingItem) — early return when `items.length <= 2` is the ONLY safeguard; the button itself is also disabled in that state (line 1367). Both defensive checks are present. Good.

admin.html:1325-1328 (addRankingItem) — no upper limit on ranking items. This matches the spec ("admin can pick the number of items, not fixed at 4") but may want a soft cap (e.g. 10) later purely for UX.
